name: orbital_overhead
prompt: Generate one widescreen 16-bit arcade pixel-art cinematic frame for Bullets of Fury, birds-eye view looking down at a climactic battle in orbit. EXACT robot identity from reference 1: huge dark gunmetal Cronos hammer robot with blue circular chest reactor, narrow silver-ridged helmet, oversized blue energy hammer, shoulder weapons. EXACT player spaceship silhouette from reference 2, silver fuselage and green highlights, flies in the lower foreground, launching a bright white missile with orange exhaust trail at the robot. The robot in upper middle is blowing apart with fire erupting from chest and arm armor, electrical blue arcs and tumbling metal fragments; hammer spinning away. Black starfield and curved blue Earth far below. Strong readable composition, cinematic depth and a clearly visible complete spaceship. Serious richly shaded 16-bit pixel art, sharp pixels, no photorealism, no text, no UI, no border.

name: earth_surface
prompt: Generate one widescreen 16-bit arcade pixel-art cinematic frame, viewed FROM PLANET EARTH looking UP into space at the destruction of the giant Cronos hammer robot from reference 1 by the player spacecraft from reference 2. Foreground bottom quarter is Earth's mountain horizon, dark terrestrial ridgeline and glowing atmospheric blue horizon. Above the thin atmosphere a huge orbital explosion lights the night sky: the recognizable dark gunmetal robot, blue chest reactor and blue giant hammer are breaking apart in space, silver/green player spaceship banking clear with a missile trail leading into the explosion. Camera is on Earth's surface; do NOT show a globe of Earth in this view. Pixel-art starry sky, blue night with orange-white blast and blue electrical arcs, rich cinematic contrast. Serious cohesive 16-bit arcade artwork, sharp pixels, no text or UI.

name: hammer_closeup
prompt: Create a production cinematic animation contact sheet for Bullets of Fury: FOUR equally sized wide frames in a precise 2 by 2 grid. Each cell an extreme closeup of the same Cronos robot HEAD from the reference, filling most of its cell with only a little upper shoulder. Exact narrow gunmetal helmet design, silver central ridge, cyan eyes, blue reactor reflections. NO ornamental horned crown, NO human face, NO new knight design. Frame1 top left: looks directly forward, confident. Frame2 top right: starts turning head to his left, camera right, illuminated by distant orange blast. Frame3 bottom left: head turned three-quarter to camera right, eyes suddenly wide luminous cyan, mechanical cheek vents opening in shock. Frame4 bottom right: SHOCKED frontal three-quarter head about to explode, armor cracks glowing electric blue and white, sparks across his face. Keep head shape consistent. Background dark starfield. Clean equal grid boundaries with no gutter, no labels, text, borders or lettering. Detailed crisp 16-bit pixel art, dramatic lighting. The game will animate a separate explosion over the fourth pose.

name: earth

Shatter the giant hammer as well into separated broken fragments; no intact giant hammer. Emphasize a finished destruction and the victorious stable ship.
